title: Nightcord at 25:00 Chapter1 Episode5 I'm a "Good Girl"

rows.Line: After school
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 2-B

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Ms. Asahina. Could I speak with you for a moment?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Ma'am? What is it?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: I wanted to know if you'd be interested in submitting the short essay you wrote for class to a competition.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What? My essay?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Yes. It was thematically sound and the other teachers all agree that it was well-written.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It really wasn't anything special, but I'd be happy to do it if you think I should.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: I do. I'll go ahead and submit it for you, then.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Mafuyu! I heard about your essay! Way to go!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Yeah! Knowing you, you'll probably get an award!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Haha, I don't know about that.
I'm sure the other essays will be really good as well.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: More importantly...the fact that you're showering me with compliments all of a sudden means you're about to ask me for a favor, doesn't it?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Oh, busted...
Please, help us with our studies again today, Lady Mafuyu!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. Thought so. The homework we got today looks pretty hard, after all. Alright. Today was only a half day, so let's study together.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Thank you! You're a lifesaver!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Thank you, Mafuyu!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
My head feels like it's going to burst!
Can we take a break?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: We haven't even been at it an hour, you know.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I guess this is pretty hard, though.
A short break might be a good idea.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Mafuyu, you're so nice. You never get upset and you never brag about having good grades or being good at sports!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Yeah. Sometimes it's hard to believe people like you actually exist!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, stop. What is it you want this time?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: No more favors! Honest! I do feel a little bad, though. Are you sure you're okay always helping us like this?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Yeah! Mafuyu, you always go out of your way to do what we ask, but you never really ask for anything in return.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Yeah. We'd be happy to do something you'd like to do, you know.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Something I'd like to do?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hm... I want everyone else to do what they want to do. Seeing others happy makes me happy.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Ack! The light! It's blinding!
She's not an angel, she's a goddess!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Mafuyu! Why couldn't I have been born as your little sister!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Ah! Watch out! You can't just glom onto people like that.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Alright, you two. Break time's over.
Time to get back to studying.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A & B
rows.Line: Yes, ma'am!
Mafuyu's Room

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Alright...

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <Oh, Yuki? You're here. How's it going?>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <Amia? I'm not used to seeing you on this early.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <My usual shift at work was changed to tomorrow, so I was getting some stuff done.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <I didn't think you were usually on this time of day either.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <I had a short day at school today, so I thought I'd get some work done I can't usually do on weekdays.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <You sure are serious about all this, aren't you?>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line:
<No more than anybody else.
You all work so hard, so I'm just trying to do my part as well.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
I'm going to the store.
I was thinking of making cream stew for dinner. What do you think?

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <Sorry, Amia. Give me a minute.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <Sure thing.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That sounds great. Thanks, Mom.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Okay, cream stew it is.
Oh, how'd your study session with your friends go today?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
It was fun.
They were really happy when the stuff they didn't understand finally started to click.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
That's nice.
Just remember to say no to something if it's too much of an inconvenience, even if they are your friends.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: You'd be better off spending time with people who can challenge you rather than those who always need your help. That way you'd actually be learning something as well.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Make sure you're valuing your own time.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay, I will.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Anyway, I'll be back in a little while.

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <Yuki, was that your mom just now?>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <Yeah. Sorry about that.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line:
<No, don't mention it.
I feel like I should be the one apologizing for eavesdropping.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line:
<But what she just said...
Did she mean she didn't want you to be friends with kids who struggle at school?>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <Well, I think she meant it more as advice to try and study with the smarter kids from time to time.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <I guess you could also take it like that, but...>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <It sounds more like she's saying to pick your friends better. That doesn't bother you?>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <I don't think I'd like it very much if somebody tried to push their own values on me or told me their way of doing things was better.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <Oh, I'm not saying that's what your mom was doing, though.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <Yuki? You okay?>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <Oh, yeah, I'm fine. That kind of stuff doesn't really bother me, I guess. I was just thinking how people can view these things differently.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <I see. Everybody's different, I guess. If it doesn't bother you, then great. Oh, sorry for talking so long. I should get back to work.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <I should get some work done, too.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <Phew... This seems like a good place to stop for now.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mom's Voice
rows.Line: Dinner's ready!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <Amia, I'm going to log off for a while. I'll be back on later tonight.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <Okay! Later!>
Asahina Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: This looks delicious! Thanks Mom.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. Eat up while it's warm, honey.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Mm.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Mafuyu, you're entering your second year at school this year. How are your university entrance exam studies going?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: They're going just fine. Prep school is actually pretty fun.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: It'd be great if your dream of becoming a doctor came true. I'm sure you'll get into whatever university you want, but you should probably choose which one you like best soon.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Which one I like best...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Yes. Your father and I took the liberty of gathering some materials from a few schools we think would be good. You should look through them later.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: They're all schools that'll help you learn to your full potential.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, thanks.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
The decision is up to you, though.
You could even study abroad if that's what you want. If there's anything you want to discuss, just let us know.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: That's right. You should do whatever it is you want to, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Just make sure you give it plenty of thought, okay?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
Hey now, stop babying Mafuyu.
She's more than capable of making her own decisions.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: She's our pride and joy, after all.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, you're right. Don't worry, I'll think it through carefully.

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Mafuyu's Room

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: So annoying...

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Great job as usual, Ms. Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: We'd be happy to do something you'd like to do, you know.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Just make sure you give it plenty of thought, okay?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: She's our pride and joy, after all.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What I want to do...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Does such a thing even exist?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I just don't know...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Miku...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I wish I could just stay in SEKAI forever.
